name: Web Search
description: Search the web from the agent. Provider-pluggable; ships with Brave as the default.

tool.name: WebSearch
tool.description: Search the web for current information. Returns ranked hits with title, URL, snippet, age, and source. Use type='news' for time-sensitive queries (recent events, breaking news); default 'web' for general lookups, documentation, and reference material. Use format='json' only when you need to extract specific fields programmatically; the default 'text' is more compact and easier to read inline.

query.description: The search query. Max 400 characters. Brevity helps; most providers do better with 2-6 well-chosen keywords than full sentences.

type.description: Search vertical. 'web' = general results; 'news' = time-sensitive recent articles.

count.description: How many hits to return. Default 10. Smaller is usually better; top 5 are typically the only ones worth reading.

offset.description: Page index (0-based). Use to paginate beyond the first page.

freshness.description: Time filter: 'pd' (past day), 'pw' (past week), 'pm' (past month), 'py' (past year), or 'YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD' for a custom range.

country.description: ISO-2 country code (e.g. 'US', 'DE') or 'ALL'. Affects result region.

format.description: Result format. 'text' (default) returns a compact human-readable list. 'json' returns a structured shape with the same fields, suitable when you need to extract specific values.
